title: Concept: Dependency declared through the GitHub shorthand
description: package.json declares a bare `owner/repo` specifier that bypasses the registry, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a bare `owner/repo` specifier that bypasses the registry.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a bare `owner/repo` specifier that bypasses the registry.
